mechanism: one core owns whole batches; retain full ordered row maxima in UB and perform original ReduceSum without SyncAll or maxima GM traffic
gate: paired SDK static full tiles; ns=1, tileM=128, M>128 and <=8192; predicted serial row-tile waves no greater than original
GM: original workspace allocation unchanged (conservative); core scratch offsets retain two slots; maxima region unused in new branch
math: original Matmul tiling and K accumulation unchanged; same row maxima and original SDK ReduceSum count/order
sync: same two-slot AIC/AIV handshake; step persists across batches; no cross-core dependency because one core owns every row in a batch
launch: one mixed kernel; batchCores=min(availableCoreNum,batch); never cache tensor outputs
